questions.question: In 2023, what was the average number of 30-day equivalent prescription fills for a Medicare Advantage Part D enrollee who was deemed eligible for the low-income subsidy?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_part_d_utilization_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR UTLZN D 1_CPS_12UPD', header=None)
# Row 26 is 'Beneficiaries Deemed Eligible for LIS²' under 'Average Prescription Drug Events (Fills) per Part D Enrollee'
# Column S (col 18) is 2023 Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Plan
# Locate row containing 'Beneficiaries Deemed Eligible' in the fills per enrollee section
# Excel row 26 corresponds to index 25
result = float(df.iloc[25, 18])

questions.question: Did Medicare Advantage Part D plans have more overall enrollees than stand-alone prescription drug plans in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_part_d_utilization_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR UTLZN D 2_CPS_12UPD', header=None)
# In 2023: col R (index 17) is Stand-Alone, col S (index 18) is MA-PD
# Row index 7 corresponds to Overall Enrollees
pdp_enrollees = df.iloc[7, 17]
mapd_enrollees = df.iloc[7, 18]
result = 'yes' if mapd_enrollees > pdp_enrollees else 'no'

questions.question: Among the 50 US states, which three states had the highest average gross drug cost per Medicare Part D enrollee in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_part_d_utilization_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR UTLZN D 6_CPS_12UPD', header=None)
# States are located in rows 8 to 58 (Excel rows 8 to 58, index 7 to 57)
# Column A is area name, Column H (index 7) is Overall Part D Average Gross Drug Cost Per Part D Enrollee
states_df = df.iloc[7:58, [0, 7]].copy()
states_df.columns = ['state', 'cost']
# Exclude DC if present (DC is index 15, row 16)
# Question asks: 'Among the 50 US states'
states_df = states_df[states_df['state'] != 'District of Columbia']
states_df['cost'] = pd.to_numeric(states_df['cost'])
top3 = states_df.sort_values(by='cost', ascending=False).head(3)['state'].tolist()
result = top3

questions.question: In 2023, what was the difference in total Medicare Part D utilizers between female beneficiaries and male beneficiaries?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_part_d_utilization_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR UTLZN D 5_CPS_12UPD', header=None)
# Female row: index 24 (Excel row 25), Male row: index 23 (Excel row 24)
# Column B (index 1) is Total Medicare Part D Utilizers
male_utilizers = df.iloc[23, 1]
female_utilizers = df.iloc[24, 1]
result = int(female_utilizers - male_utilizers)

questions.question: How many US states had an average gross drug cost per Part D utilizer exceeding $6,000 in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_part_d_utilization_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR UTLZN D 7_CPS_12UPD', header=None)
# States start at row index 7 (Alabama) through row index 57 (Wyoming)
states_df = df.iloc[7:58, [0, 7]].copy()
states_df.columns = ['state', 'cost']
states_df = states_df[states_df['state'] != 'District of Columbia']
states_df['cost'] = pd.to_numeric(states_df['cost'])
result = int((states_df['cost'] > 6000).sum())
